text:
Evan Murphy: Quick incident summary: between 12:07-12:27 UTC we saw an I/O saturation event in apac-embed-store that increased embedding latency and caused ~0.6% 5xx across hosted embeddings. Customers impacted intermittently; we opened this thread for coordination and customer comms.

Priya Nair: Thanks Evan. What triggered the saturation?

Evan Murphy: Preliminary: a background compaction job was mis-scheduled to run on primary shard instead of replica due to a cron mis-flag; compaction consumed disk IO and bumped queue latencies.

ops-bot: mitigation: throttle-compaction job disabled (ID: job-cc-77) at 12:14 UTC, traffic shifted to cold-read pools, rolling restart of embed-store pod group began at 12:16 UTC.

Tomás Alvarez: Metrics: p95 embeddings peaked at ~1.9s, p50 unaffected. Error rate returned to baseline by 12:29 UTC after the restart. No customer data lost.

Priya Nair: Customer comms draft posted to #support-digest. Suggest we note the window, root cause (compaction mis-schedule), mitigations taken, and actions to prevent recurrence.

CS-bot: Status page entry created: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/2896002462  includes brief timeline.

Evan Murphy: Short SRE commands for follow-up:

```bash
# find compaction jobs scheduled on primary nodes
rdw-admin jobs list --filter "type:compaction AND target:primary" --region apac
# disable specific job
rdw-admin jobs disable job-cc-77 --force
```

Toms Alvarez: Follow-ups: Evan to produce timeline + RCA, Priya to finalize customer note, infra to add CI gate preventing compaction-on-primary schedules. Target: RCA + customer update within 6 business hours.

Evan Murphy: I'll post the detailed timeline here once ready and open the infra PR for the CI gate.

Priya Nair: Thanks team. I'll also surface this to account reps for any customers who ping.

ops-bot: incident-severity: SEV3 (transient customer-impacting latency).
